item.title: Giving away island sovereignty act of stupidity, says man who wants to be given island
Man breaks single journey world record for sarcastic comments made to other drivers
item.description: A Leeds man has broke his own world record for the most sarcastic comments made to other drivers on a single car journey, it has been revealed. Mike McBride, 42, surpassed his previous mark of 38 remarks made from the safety of the driving seat of his Toyota Prius on a single segment of the A65 from Kirkstall to Leeds, in standing traffic in rush hour, reaching a remarkable 45 sarcastic comments in less than an hour. No internet horror-sounds alright
item.description: Iran has cut off the internet to its people, prompting wide scale outrage online-which fortunately they don't have to read.
